findings.detail: The identity probes inspect a symlink itself rather than its target. With input.json pointing to source.json, rendering input.json onto source.json compares different inode identities and then replaces the underlying JSON with HTML. The mode probe has the same omission: rendering onto a symlink to a private page can give its replacement the symlink's broader permissions. These defects predate the change; the new exception comments approve the affected probes.
findings.evidence: The probes at lines 1363 and 1478-1479 omit -L. The installed /usr/share/man/man1/stat.1 explicitly documents lstat as the default and -L as selecting the target. The identity guard at line 1480 therefore misses the input symlink, and write_output subsequently renames HTML onto source.json.
findings.title: Sibling input forms: metadata probes do not follow symlinks

findings.detail: When both stat variants fail, the script continues without the metadata needed for its protections. For example, with stat unavailable on PATH, rendering an existing 0600 page under umask 022 replaces it with a 0644 page. Rendering with identical input and output also bypasses the identity guard and overwrites the JSON. These defects predate the change; the new annotations describe the unsafe fallbacks as intentional.
findings.evidence: Line 1363 converts both failures to an empty mode; lines 1365-1367 substitute the current umask, and lines 1372-1373 apply it before replacement. Lines 1478-1480 similarly turn failed identity reads into a skipped guard. require_jq checks no stat prerequisite.
findings.title: Absent or partial data: failed metadata probes bypass file protections

findings.detail: When the checkout belongs to a different repository, the diagnostic prints its complete origin URL. An HTTPS origin such as https://user:SECRET@github.com/acme/other.git therefore exposes the embedded credential while gathering acme/widgets. This predates the change and remains in the newly annotated mismatch path.
findings.evidence: Line 1054 captures git remote get-url origin without sanitizing it. Lines 1055-1056 interpolate that raw value into local-notice.txt, which lines 1336-1337 replay to stderr. The sibling backlog-gather mismatch diagnostic names only the expected repository.
findings.title: Untrusted data in commands: the origin diagnostic exposes URL credentials

findings.detail: The gather helpers pass relative filenames beginning with a dash directly to jq. For example, backlog-gather finish -gather.json analysis.json output.json rejects an existing valid gather as malformed JSON because jq interprets its name as an option. The same problem affects bugs-gather input files. This predates the change; report-board already handles this sibling input form with operand().
findings.evidence: backlog-gather lines 643-644 pass arguments unchanged to require_json_file, whose jq invocation is at line 327. bugs-gather repeats that invocation at line 876 and also passes assessment paths directly at line 1394. report-board lines 1079-1083 instead prefix dash-leading paths with ./ before invoking readers.
findings.title: Sibling input forms: gather readers treat dash-leading filenames as options

findings.detail: Every mkdir failure is treated as another sync holding the lock. If the existing cache directory is not writable and no save.lock exists, the script discards the permission error, retries, then tells the reader another sync is saving and suggests removing a nonexistent lock. This diagnostic defect predates the change; the new exception covers failures beyond the stated expected contention.
findings.evidence: cmd_save permits an existing directory through mkdir -p at line 1508. acquire_save_lock suppresses every mkdir error at line 858 and has only the contention diagnostic at line 860, without checking whether the lock exists or retaining the actual error.
findings.title: Absent or partial data: lock creation errors are always reported as contention
